questions.scenario: Your school is hosting its massive Annual Day. Which responsibility do you immediately claim?

options.text: Creating the minute-by-minute schedule and managing the total budget.
Handling the backstage logistics—making sure the mics, lighting, and props work perfectly.
Greeting the chief guests, parents, and keeping nervous participants calm.
Designing the stage backdrop, choosing the lighting colors, and decorating the entrance.

questions.scenario: You are organizing a surprise birthday party for your best friend. What is your top priority?

options.text: Tracking who is coming, calculating costs per person, and sticking to the timeline.
Finding the best location, checking the menu, and making sure the music system works.
Making sure no one feels left out and everyone is mingling and having a great time.
Picking a unique theme, buying matching balloons, and designing a stunning cake.

questions.scenario: Disaster strikes! The power goes out in the middle of a school performance. What is your instinct?

options.text: Quickly rewriting the schedule to figure out which acts to skip or delay.
Running to find the electrician or checking the generator immediately.
Jumping on stage to joke with the audience and keep the crowd entertained.
Getting everyone to turn on their phone flashlights to create a magical concert vibe.

questions.scenario: Your friends are planning a weekend trip. What role do you naturally fall into?

options.text: The Itinerary Master: I know exactly what time we leave and where we are going.
The Navigator: I figure out the transport, the routes, and where we are eating.
The Peacemaker: I resolve arguments about where to go and make sure everyone is happy.
The Hype Builder: I make a cool poster or matching t-shirts for the trip.

questions.scenario: What is your secret superpower during a chaotic group project?

options.text: Keeping everyone on track with strict deadlines and to-do lists.
Gathering all the raw materials and actually putting the physical project together.
Motivating the lazy team members without starting a fight.
Making the final presentation look incredibly professional and beautiful.

questions.scenario: If you had to organize a massive e-sports or gaming tournament, what would you focus on?

options.text: Creating the tournament brackets, rules, and scoring system.
Setting up the PCs, testing the internet speed, and managing the cables.
Hyping up the players, doing commentary, and managing the live audience.
Designing the digital banners, the cool lighting for the stage, and the trophy.

questions.scenario: Look at your bedroom or study desk right now. How would you describe it?

options.text: Highly organized with a calendar, sticky notes, and a clear plan for the week.
Functional and efficient. Everything is exactly where I can grab it quickly.
Welcoming. I always have extra snacks or seating in case friends drop by.
Aesthetically pleasing with posters, fairy lights, and a matching color scheme.

questions.scenario: You are attending a massive family wedding. What are you most likely doing?

options.text: Checking my watch to see if the caterers are serving dinner on time.
Helping coordinate the parking or directing the DJ where to set up.
Chatting with distant relatives and making sure the elders are comfortable.
Judging (or admiring) the floral arrangements, centerpieces, and stage design.

questions.scenario: When you are tasked with leading a new project, what app do you open first?

options.text: Google Sheets or Excel to make a budget and a timeline.
Google Maps or booking apps to check venues and logistics.
WhatsApp to create a group chat and start hyping people up.
Pinterest or Instagram to find visual inspiration and mood boards.

questions.scenario: What is the best compliment someone could give you after you host an event?

options.text: 'Everything ran so smoothly and exactly on time! You're so organized.'
'The venue setup was flawless, not a single technical glitch!'
'I felt so welcomed and taken care of, the vibe was amazingly positive!'
'It looked like a movie! The decorations and lights were unreal!'

Event_Planner.title: Event Coordinator / Project Manager
Event_Planner.primary_match_text: You are the ultimate mastermind. You love structure, tracking budgets, and creating timelines. You see the big picture and know how to bring all the moving parts together seamlessly.
Event_Planner.day_in_the_life: Meeting with corporate clients to plan massive conferences, creating detailed spreadsheets, hiring vendors, and ensuring an event stays under budget and on schedule.
Event_Planner.alternative_match_text: Because of your high-level organizational skills, working as a Project Manager in corporate business or IT is a fantastic backup plan.
Event_Planner.roadmap: Take Commerce or Humanities in 11th/12th. Pursue a BBA in Event Management, Public Relations, or Hospitality. Learn project management software.

Operations_Manager.title: Venue & Operations Manager
Operations_Manager.primary_match_text: You are the problem-solver. You are highly practical, great at managing physical spaces, and you know how to handle logistics, tech setups, and emergencies on the ground.
Operations_Manager.day_in_the_life: Managing large stadiums or concert arenas, coordinating security, overseeing the stage build-out, and making sure thousands of people enter and exit safely.
Operations_Manager.alternative_match_text: Since you are great at managing physical movement and problem-solving, Supply Chain Management or Hotel Operations is a perfect alternative.
Operations_Manager.roadmap: Any stream in 11th/12th. Pursue a degree in Hotel Management, BBA in Logistics, or Event Operations. Gain on-the-ground experience through internships.

Guest_Relations_Manager.title: Guest Relations / VIP Hospitality Manager
Guest_Relations_Manager.primary_match_text: You are the ultimate people person. You have high emotional intelligence, excellent communication skills, and a natural ability to make everyone feel special and comfortable.
Guest_Relations_Manager.day_in_the_life: Handling celebrity VIPs at music festivals, resolving guest complaints at luxury hotels, and ensuring that every attendee leaves with a smile on their face.
Guest_Relations_Manager.alternative_match_text: With your top-tier communication and charm, a career in Public Relations (PR), Human Resources, or Luxury Sales would also be highly successful.
Guest_Relations_Manager.roadmap: Take Humanities or Commerce in 11th/12th. Pursue a BA in Mass Communication, Public Relations, or a Degree in Hospitality/Hotel Management.

Event_Designer.title: Event Designer & Stylist
Event_Designer.primary_match_text: You are the visionary. You have an incredible eye for aesthetics, colors, and themes. You don't just want an event to function well; you want it to look absolutely magical.
Event_Designer.day_in_the_life: Creating 3D models of wedding stages, selecting floral arrangements, designing lighting setups, and transforming boring halls into completely different worlds.
Event_Designer.alternative_match_text: Because you have such a strong sense of aesthetics and spatial design, Interior Designing or Set Designing for films is an amazing alternative path.
Event_Designer.roadmap: Take Any Stream (Fine Arts preferred) in 11th/12th. Pursue a B.Des (Bachelor of Design) in Interior Design, Exhibition Design, or Fine Arts. Build a visual portfolio.
